description: Statically vet this machine's AI assistant configuration - hook commands, MCP server definitions, permission grants and rules (allow, ask, deny), installed plugins and skills - and return the masked JSON findings report as a text block. Read-only: config files are opened for reading and never written. Project configuration is read at the server process's working directory, at the top of its git repository and, in a linked worktree, at the main checkout.
name: vet_configs
title: Vet assistant configuration
